title: Tensorfy
tagline: Tensorfy is an application built to clarify the complexity of blockchain transactions on the StarkNet platform by leveragin LLm's to explain simulated execution with natural language

prizes.placement: Innovative idea built on top of Argent
prizes.title: Innovative idea built on top of Argent

description:
Integrated directly into a StarkNet wallet, Tensorfy leverages sophisticated AI technology to interpret complex call data and encoded transaction details, translating them into easy-to-understand plain text
Before executing a transaction, users receive a concise explanation of what will occur, ensuring full transparency and understanding. This feature boosts user confidence and comprehension, making it easier for everyone—from blockchain beginners to seasoned experts—to navigate and manage their transactions securely and efficiently on StarkNet.
how_its_made:
Before executing a transaction, users receive a concise explanation of what will occur, ensuring full transparency and understanding. This feature boosts user confidence and comprehension, making it easier for everyone—from blockchain beginners to seasoned experts—to navigate and manage their transactions securely and efficiently on StarkNet.
We use a custom RPC and LLM pipe to simulate and translate a transaction to plain then to be confirmed or declined.
